column1: # Every production site that reads a `@qmx-threshold` override, directly or
# through AbstractRule. The counterfactual pass of the threshold audit claims
# that removing the override map changes a run only through these sites, so the
# sites are enumerated rather than asserted.
# ROW COUNT: 36 matches in 27 files, of which one (HardcodedCredentialsRule:141) is a
# docblock reference and not a call. The two lookup roots are
# LongParameterListRule is the only rule that calls the latter itself.
# WHAT THIS METHOD DOES NOT SEE
# - A rule that reads the override map through some other name. The grep is on
#   three method names; the closed check is that AnalysisContext exposes exactly
#   one accessor and it has two callers in src.
# - Non-rule readers of the same annotations. Three exist and none is a
#   threshold decision: ThresholdOverrideSupportReader (declares whether a rule
#   accepts overrides at all), the per-rule OverrideValidatorInterface
#   implementations (reject a malformed override at extraction time, publishing
#   baseline:explain). The audit's diff must therefore be taken over rule
